heading.zh-Hant: 出身與維也納警界起步
heading.en: Origins and the start of a police career

body.zh-Hant: 《新德意志傳記》（NDB，米夏埃爾·格勒撰）記載，約翰內斯（約翰）·紹伯爾1874年11月14日生於上奧地利的佩爾格。他在維也納攻讀法律，1898年進入維也納市政府任職，擔任警察方面的見習。NDB稱他1918年起擔任維也納警察總監，是帝制時代最後一任，之後為共和國效力；國會傳記同樣列出他1918年起任維也納警察總監。
body.en: According to the Neue Deutsche Biographie (entry by Michael Gehler), Johannes (Johann) Schober was born on 14 November 1874 at Perg in Upper Austria. He studied law in Vienna and in 1898 took a post with the Vienna municipal administration as a trainee attached to the police. The NDB says that from 1918 he was police president of Vienna, the last imperial holder of the post, and then served the republic; the parliamentary biography likewise lists him as Vienna police president from 1918.

heading.zh-Hant: 從國家警察到全國公共安全總管
heading.en: From the state police to head of public security

body.zh-Hant: 維也納歷史館（Wien Geschichte Wiki，採自切爾內克《維也納歷史辭典》）記載，紹伯爾1913年接掌國家警察，1918年6月11日出任維也納警察局長，同年11月30日被任命為維也納警察總監，12月8日又受託領導全國的公共安全事務。該條目說，他把公共安全機構作為君主國唯一完整保存的權力機器帶入共和國，因此聲望上升。
body.en: The Wien Geschichte Wiki (drawing on Czeike's Historisches Lexikon Wien) records that Schober took over the state police in 1913, became head of the Vienna police directorate on 11 June 1918, was appointed police president of Vienna on 30 November 1918, and on 8 December was entrusted with the whole public security service. The entry says he carried the security apparatus, the only monarchy power structure left intact, over into the republic, which raised his standing.

heading.zh-Hant: 鎮壓共產黨人、國際刑警與七月事件
heading.en: Suppression of the Communists, Interpol and July 1927

body.zh-Hant: NDB寫道，1919年6月14日他下令逮捕與匈牙利庫恩（貝拉·庫恩）蘇維埃運動有關的奧地利共產黨領導人，隔天的大規模抗議造成12人死亡；該條目認為他的強硬作風使他得到市民階層讚賞，並阻止了蘇維埃共和國的建立。NDB又說，1923年他成為在維也納新成立的「國際刑警」（Interpol）首長；奧地利內政部刊物稱他是首任國際刑警委員會（IKPK）主席。1927年7月沙滕多夫（布爾根蘭）陪審團審判之後，維也納工人抗議遭到血腥鎮壓，NDB指他對此負責。
body.en: The NDB writes that on 14 June 1919 he had leading Austrian Communists arrested, men linked to Béla Kun's Hungarian soviet movement, and that the mass protests of the next day left 12 dead. It says his firm line won him the esteem of the middle class and that he prevented a soviet republic from being set up. It adds that in 1923 he became head of the newly founded "Interpol" in Vienna; an Austrian interior ministry publication calls him the first president of the IKPK. After the Schattendorf jury trial of July 1927, the bloody suppression of workers' protests in Vienna was, the NDB says, his responsibility.

heading.en: First chancellorship, 1921-1922

body.zh-Hant: 國會傳記記載，紹伯爾1921年6月21日至1922年5月31日任聯邦總理。奧地利歷史之家（Haus der Geschichte Österreich）的文章說明，這是基督教社會黨與德意志民族派組成、以無黨派閣員為主的政府，1921年6月21日宣誓就職，紹伯爾本人沒有正式黨籍，但被視為屬大德意志民族派的圈子。他在任期間，一項與捷克斯洛伐克的條約本應幫助國家擺脫財政危機，卻惹惱德意志民族派；內政部刊物則記載，他辭職後由瓦爾特·布賴斯基受託主持政府，但只當了一天總理。同一份國會紀錄顯示，他在1921年6月至1922年1月兼管外交部，1922年1月27日至5月31日兼管內政與教育部。
body.en: The parliamentary biography records Schober as federal chancellor from 21 June 1921 to 31 May 1922. The Haus der Geschichte Österreich explains that the Christian Socials and German Nationals formed a government of mainly non-party ministers, sworn in on 21 June 1921; Schober had no official party membership but was counted in the German National milieu. A treaty with Czechoslovakia meant to ease the financial crisis angered the German Nationals; an interior ministry publication adds that after he resigned Walter Breisky led the government for only one day. The same record shows him in charge of the foreign ministry from June 1921 to January 1922 and of the interior and education ministry from 27 January to 31 May 1922.

heading.zh-Hant: 拉納條約與重回警察局
heading.en: The Treaty of Lana and the return to the police

body.zh-Hant: 維也納歷史館說，紹伯爾1921至1922年以無黨派身分領導官員內閣，並獲基督教社會黨支持以對抗社會民主黨；他以外交部長身分簽署1921年12月與捷克斯洛伐克的拉納條約，其中含禁止合併條款，受到大德意志派批評。內閣倒台後，他在塞佩爾新政府下於1922年5月31日重新領導警察局，並成為國際刑警委員會的共同創辦人，該委員會選他為主席、以維也納為常設地。
body.en: The Wien Geschichte Wiki says Schober led an official-run cabinet in 1921-22 as an independent, backed by the Christian Socials against the Social Democrats; as foreign minister he signed the Treaty of Lana with Czechoslovakia in December 1921, which contained a ban on union with Germany and was criticised by the Greater Germans. After the cabinet fell he resumed leadership of the police directorate under the new Seipel government on 31 May 1922 and became a co-founder of the International Criminal Police Commission, which elected him president and Vienna its permanent seat.

heading.zh-Hant: 司法宮火災與開槍命令
heading.en: The Justizpalast fire and the order to fire

body.zh-Hant: 維也納歷史館的司法宮火災條目稱，1927年7月15日司法宮火災當天，由警察總監紹伯爾調動的部隊以極端殘暴方式行動，14時30分他下達開槍命令；該館的紹伯爾條目說明，他是在塞佩爾授權、騎警驅不散人群之後決定開火。該條目又引述維也納市2011至2013年委託的歷史學者研究小組最終報告，稱他對94人死亡負主要責任。
body.en: The Wien Geschichte Wiki's Justizpalastbrand entry says that on 15 July 1927 the units mobilised by police president Schober acted with extreme brutality and that at 14:30 he gave the order to fire; his own entry explains that he decided to open fire with Seipel's authorisation after mounted units failed to disperse the crowd. The same entry cites the final report of a historians' group that studied Vienna's street names from 2011 to 2013, which holds him chiefly responsible for 94 deaths.

heading.zh-Hant: 1929至1930年的第二任總理與憲法改革
heading.en: Second chancellorship and the 1929 constitutional reform, 1929-1930

body.zh-Hant: 國會傳記列出，紹伯爾1929年9月26日至1930年9月30日再度出任聯邦總理，同時在1929年9月26日至10月16日暫管財政部與教育部。奧地利歷史之家的文章說，議會中保守派與德意志民族派多數同意再度任命他，內閣多由無黨派官員組成；政府不久後在國民議會失去支持。NDB稱，他任總理時完成了1929年的憲法改革，強化了聯邦總統的權力，並說他在1930年海牙會議上促成賠款的取消。
body.en: The parliamentary biography lists Schober as federal chancellor again from 26 September 1929 to 30 September 1930, and as temporarily in charge of the finance and education ministries from 26 September to 16 October 1929. The Haus der Geschichte Österreich article says a conservative and German National majority in parliament agreed to reappoint him, with another cabinet of mostly non-party officials, and that the government soon lost support in the National Council. The NDB says that as chancellor he completed the constitutional reform of 1929, which strengthened the federal president, and that at the Hague conference of 1930 he obtained the lifting of reparations.

heading.zh-Hant: 民族經濟集團、副總理與去世
heading.en: National Economic Block, vice chancellor and death

body.zh-Hant: NDB記載，1930年紹伯爾以大德意志人民黨代表的身分，與自由派的農民聯盟組成「民族經濟集團」（「紹伯爾集團」），以19個席次取得選舉勝利。國會傳記顯示，他1930年12月2日起為國民議會議員（NWB），1930年12月4日至1932年1月29日任副總理並負責外交事務。NDB說，他與德國的庫爾提烏斯（尤利烏斯·庫爾提烏斯）共同構想德奧關稅同盟，卻因消息提前洩漏而失敗。他1932年8月19日在巴登去世，NDB稱他是第一共和最具影響力的人物之一。
body.en: The NDB records that in 1930 Schober, as a representative of the Greater German People's Party, formed the "National Economic Block" (the "Schober Block") with the liberal Landbund and won an election success of 19 seats. The parliamentary biography shows him as a member of the National Council (NWB) from 2 December 1930, and as vice chancellor and in charge of foreign affairs from 4 December 1930 to 29 January 1932. The NDB says he and the German Julius Curtius devised the plan for a German-Austrian customs union, which failed after premature disclosure. He died at Baden on 19 August 1932; the NDB calls him one of the most influential figures of the First Republic.

heading.en: Vice-chancellor and foreign minister

body.zh-Hant: 維也納歷史館記載，紹伯爾1930年9月因人事爭執再度辭去總理，並在1930年11月9日選舉中擔任「紹伯爾集團」（民族自由派陣營，由大德意志黨與農民聯盟組成）的名單領銜人；1930年12月4日至1932年1月29日，他任副總理。
body.en: The Wien Geschichte Wiki records that Schober had to resign again in September 1930 after a personnel dispute and, for the elections of 9 November 1930, headed the list of the "Schoberblock" (the national-liberal camp of Greater Germans and Landbund); from 4 December 1930 to 29 January 1932 he was vice-chancellor.

heading.en: Origins and education

body.zh-Hant: 孔祥熙生於中國山西省。1896至1900年，他就讀於通州的華北協和書院；1906年畢業於美國俄亥俄州的歐柏林學院，1907年又從耶魯大學取得經濟學碩士學位。胡佛檔案的指南把他描述為受過美式教育的中國人。
body.en: H. H. Kung was born in Shanxi Province, China. He studied at North China Union College in Tongzhou from 1896 to 1900, graduated from Oberlin College in Ohio in 1906, and earned an M.A. in economics at Yale University in 1907.

citations.quote: 1881 Born, Shanxi Province, China

heading.zh-Hant: 婚姻、入國民黨與工商部
heading.en: Marriage, joining the Kuomintang, and the industry ministry

body.zh-Hant: 1913年，孔祥熙任東京中華基督教青年會秘書。1914年，孔祥熙與宋靄齡結婚。1924年他加入中國國民黨。1928年出任工商部部長，1929年當選國民黨中央執行委員會委員。工商部長一職，另有說法為1928至1931年任職。另有說法稱他於1931年加入國民黨中央執行委員會。
body.en: In 1913 Kung was secretary of the Chinese YMCA in Tokyo. Kung married Soong Ai-ling in 1914 and joined the Kuomintang in 1924. He was named Minister of Industry and Commerce in 1928 and elected to the KMT Central Executive Committee in 1929. Another account gives his tenure as industry and commerce minister as 1928-31. Another account says he joined the KMT central executive committee in 1931.

citations.quote: 1914 Married Soong E-ling 宋靄齡
1924 Joined the Kuomintang (KMT)
1928 Named Minister of Industry and Commerce
1929 Elected to the KMT Central Executive Committee
as minister of industry and commerce (1928–31)

In 1931 he joined the central executive committee of the Kuomintang.

heading.en: Finance minister and Premier

body.zh-Hant: 1933年，孔祥熙出任行政院副院長與財政部長，並兼任中國銀行總裁。歐柏林學院的傳記稱，他自1938年1月至1939年11月擔任中華民國行政院院長。他於1967年在紐約長島去世。
body.en: In 1933 Kung became Vice-Premier of the Executive Yuan and Minister of Finance and also Governor of the Bank of China. An Oberlin biography says he served as Premier of the Republic of China from January 1938 to November 1939. He died on Long Island, New York, in 1967.

Minister of Finance

heading.en: Serving as Premier

body.zh-Hant: 行政院官網的歷任院長名單載明，孔祥熙的院長任期為民國27年1月1日至民國28年12月11日，即1938年1月1日至1939年12月11日。他在此之前任行政院副院長，1938年初升任院長。胡佛研究院的介紹稱，1938年他短暫接替蔣中正出任院長。
body.en: The Executive Yuan's list of past premiers gives Kung's term as 1 January 1938 to 11 December 1939. He had been vice premier before and was promoted to premier in early 1938. The Hoover Institution says he briefly succeeded Chiang Kai-shek as premier in 1938.

citations.locator: 歷任院長 行憲前表，孔祥熙列

heading.en: Vice premier and move to the United States

body.zh-Hant: 國史館館刊的文章指出，孔祥熙後任行政院長，旋改任副院長，仍兼財政部長及中央銀行總裁。胡佛研究院的介紹稱，蔣中正翌年復任院長後，孔祥熙繼續任副院長並兼財政部長。1948年他隨家人遷居美國。
body.en: A journal article from Academia Historica says Kung became premier, was soon shifted to vice premier, and remained finance minister and governor of the Central Bank. Hoover says he continued as vice premier and finance minister after Chiang resumed the premiership, and that he moved to the United States with his family in 1948.

people.nameZh: 奧雷利奧·莫斯克拉·納瓦埃斯

heading.en: Background and medical training

body.zh-Hant: 莫斯克拉·納瓦埃斯是厄瓜多爾政治人物，曾領導激進自由黨。他在拉薩爾學院（Instituto La Salle）完成小學，在聖加夫列爾中學（colegio San Gabriel）讀中學，1906年1月在中央大學修完醫學課程。
body.en: Mosquera Narváez was an Ecuadorian politician who led the Radical Liberal Party. He attended the Instituto La Salle for primary school and the colegio San Gabriel for secondary school, and completed his medical degree at the Universidad Central in January 1906.

citations.quote: Político ecuatoriano. Dirigió el Partido Radical Liberal.
estudios primarios en el Instituto La Salle
secundarios en el colegio San Gabriel
carrera de medicina en la Universidad Central en enero de 1906

heading.en: Physician and rector of the Universidad Central

body.zh-Hant: 他除了擔任基多醫師協會會長，也從事教學，並於1929至1932年出任中央大學校長；1930年6月20日，他以校長身分向公共教育部長提交報告。德國國家圖書館權威檔同樣記他為厄瓜多爾中央大學校長兼院長（約1930年）。中央大學期刊刊載的1933年校長報告，也承認他任內推動改革並創設新學院。
body.en: Besides presiding over the Quito medical society, he taught, and he served as rector of the Universidad Central between 1929 and 1932. On 20 June 1930, as rector, he submitted a report to the Minister of Public Education. The German National Library authority record likewise lists him as rector and dean of the Universidad Central del Ecuador (around 1930). A 1933 rector's report published by the university journal also acknowledges that he pushed reforms and the creation of new faculties.

heading.zh-Hant: 參議院與自由黨地方組織
heading.en: Senate and Liberal Party organisation

body.zh-Hant: 在政界，他擔任過參議員及參議院副議長（1930至1931年），並於1932至1936年出任激進自由派皮欽查省委員會主席。
body.en: In politics he served as a senator and vice-president of the Senate (1930-1931), and from 1932 to 1936 he presided over the Radical Liberal Board of Pichincha.

heading.en: Presidency

body.zh-Hant: 1938年，他身為自由激進黨最高領袖時，制憲議會指定他為憲法總統，他任職至一年後猝逝。據來源，他在軍隊支持下解散國民議會並恢復1906年憲法；內閣納入日後的總統加洛·普拉薩，並關閉中央大學與胡安·蒙塔爾沃師範學院。
body.en: In 1938, while supreme director of the Liberal Radical Party, the Constituent Assembly designated him constitutional president, and he held the office until his sudden death a year later. According to the source, with army support he dissolved the National Assembly and restored the Constitution of 1906; his cabinet included the future president Galo Plaza, and he closed the Universidad Central and the Colegio Normal Juan Montalvo.

citations.quote: En 1938, siendo director supremo del Partido Liberal Radical

cargo que detentó hasta su repentino fallecimiento un año después

heading.en: Election and cabinet, December 1938

body.zh-Hant: 1938年12月1日白天至次日凌晨，臨時總統博雷羅辭職，議會連夜另覓人選，並發下選票。醫師莫斯克拉·納瓦埃斯以壓倒性多數當選；他曾任中央大學校長，當時領導激進自由黨。他在凌晨3時15分進入議場，三十分鐘後宣誓儀式即告結束。12月2日上午公布首批部長：年輕的加洛·普拉薩出任國防部長，胡利奧·托瓦爾·多諾索留在外交部。
body.en: From the morning of 1 December 1938 until the early hours of the next day, interim president Borrero resigned and the Assembly searched for a replacement overnight and distributed ballots. The physician Mosquera Narváez won by an overwhelming majority; he had been rector of the Universidad Central and now led the Radical Liberal Party. He entered the chamber at 3.15 a.m., and the swearing-in ceremony was over about thirty minutes later. On the morning of 2 December the first ministers were announced: the young Galo Plaza Lasso took National Defence and Julio Tobar Donoso stayed at the foreign ministry.

heading.en: In office: the Assembly, the university and his death

body.zh-Hant: 依過渡條款，這位憲法總統任期本可到1942年8月31日。但他任內的政府關閉了制憲議會，1939年又以校內策劃陰謀為由，把中央大學關閉數月。他在任內去世。
body.en: Under a transitory provision the constitutional president's term was to run until 31 August 1942. His government, however, closed the Constituent Assembly, and in 1939 it shut the Universidad Central for several months, arguing that a plot against the government was being hatched inside. He died in office.
